text:
lee: customer stuck on quickstart. first HTTP call from sample fails with CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED, then SDK retries and later 503. they thought billing was blocking because onboarding banner showed 'billing required'.

ana: Repro command they ran:
```
docker run --rm -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=pk_live_TEST redwood/quickstart:latest node index.js
```

lee: Logs show:
```
Error: certificate has expired (SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED)
... SDK retrying (attempt 2)
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
```

support-bot: Workspace "papertrail" is trial with low concurrency. That can produce 429s but not TLS verify failures.

ana: This is classic TLS interception by corporate proxy; container/node doesn't trust company CA. Ask user to run `curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health` to confirm issuer.

lee: Customer curl output: issuer=Corp-Intercept-CA and SSL: certificate verify failed.

infra-bot: Noted INFRA-3621 tracking missing host CAs in some node images.

ana: Short-term unblock suggestions:
- Run quickstart on a non-managed machine or cloud devbox.
- Set NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS or mount host CA into container: `-v /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt:/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt:ro`
- On Windows contact IT to trust intercept CA or use personal laptop.

lee: Product/Docs action items:
- Add "Behind corporate proxies" troubleshooting to quickstart README with examples.
- Make SDK detect CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED and output friendlier guidance linking to docs.
- Clarify onboarding banner so users don't assume billing is the cause of network/TLS errors.

onboard-bot: Note added to workspace papertrail: "docs: add proxy troubleshooting; clarify billing banner".

lee: I'm opening DOCS-820 and SDK-410. Will follow up with customer once docs/SDK patch is live. Thanks all :thumbsup:
